name: Monitor Clarification
implementation_notes: clarification_record/clarification_detail local SQLite tables added to localSchema.ts (CREATE_CLARIFICATION_RECORD/CREATE_CLARIFICATION_DETAIL, appended to CREATE_TABLE_STATEMENTS) -- mirrors boiler_room_record/boiler_room_detail's shape, following the hourly-grid (dynamic add-row/remove-row) pattern. This station has only 7 non-time_slot columns, all numeric except Findings (text) -- the SIMPLEST station in the whole project, no enum/status columns at all
clarificationRecordRepo.ts covers all 3 mobile Clarification screens (069/079/089) in one file, same convention as boilerRoomRecordRepo.ts covering screens 068/078/088

createDraft() inserts ONLY the header row -- clarification_detail rows are added one at a time by the user in Form Clarification via 'Tambah baris', exactly mirroring boilerRoomRecordRepo.ts's pattern
'Jumlah Baris Time-Slot Tercatat' counter is a plain COUNT(*) of clarification_detail rows belonging to today's records -- no filled-row filter, mirrors Boiler Room's Monitor counter exactly

Router: route name 'monitor-clarification' registered in router/index.ts -- StationListView.vue (screen-006) already had this route name pre-wired in MONITOR_ROUTE_NAMES and a 'clarification': false placeholder in draftStatusByType; this implementation wires the real clarificationRecordRepo.getDrafts() call into StationListView.vue's Promise.all, replacing that placeholder with clarification.length > 0, same additive pattern Boiler Room used for this same pre-existing scaffolding

Added the missing getClarificationDraftsMock hoisted mock, vi.mock() registration, and getClarificationDraftsMock.mockResolvedValue([]) call in every beforeEach block AND every individual it-block that manually re-sets the record-repo mocks in mobile/tests/StationListView.spec.ts (mirroring the existing getBoilerRoomDraftsMock pattern exactly) proactively, per explicit task instruction that a prior station's run omitted this and broke silently -- all 27 tests in that shared file pass

status memuat diganti LoadingState variant list (draft-list-loading). Bug diperbaiki: ketukan ganda New Data membuat 2 draft. Uji: loadingStates.screens.spec.ts (bersama, 18 Monitor: LoadingState + ketukan ganda tepat satu draft); e2e/loading-states.spec.ts memakai Monitor Boiler Room sebagai sampel.

deferred_items.description: syncService.ts's syncAllRecords() was NOT extended with a syncClarificationRecords() function (unlike Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant/Process Water/Effluent Plant/Storage Tank/Engine Room/Boiler Room, which each have one calling POST /api/clarification-records via the mobile 'Sinkronisasi' button)
deferred_items.reason: Out of this 6-screen task's explicit scope; the most recent precedent station (Boiler Room) made the same deferral decision for the same reason. The web POST/PATCH routes are already dual-guarded ('auth:web,sanctum' + operator role) so wiring this up later requires no backend route change, only a syncService.ts addition.
